chunks.title: IKEA (Ingka Group / Ingka Investments) (IKEA) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: IKEA (Ingka Group / Ingka Investments) is a Strategic Corporate / COP31 Supporter headquartered in Netherlands / Sweden. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Official COP31 Climate Supporter promoting circular economy, zero waste & renewable energy. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: COP31 Climate Supporter; separate Ingka Investments circular-economy & clean-energy corporate investment arm. Source verification: https://cop31.tr/partners/climate-supporters.

chunks.title: IKEA Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: IKEA (Ingka Group / Ingka Investments) provides the following climate financing instruments: Strategic Circular Pilot Partner, Ingka Investments Referral (Separate Mandate). Typical transaction ticket range is USD 0 to USD 50,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Climate-Tech Startup, Large Corporate, SME.

chunks.title: IKEA Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by IKEA (Ingka Group / Ingka Investments): Zero Waste & Circular Economy, Renewable Energy, Sustainable Supply Chains. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Europe, Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: IKEA Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete IKEA's application form: Separate COP31 Supporter participation from formal Ingka Investments mandate; Demonstrate measurable circular-waste or retail decarbonization impact. Explicit exclusion rules: Treating COP31 Supporter sponsorship as confirmed funding. Official application portal: https://cop31.tr/partners/climate-supporters.

chunks.title: IKEA Form Template: Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form
chunks.text: IKEA (Ingka Group / Ingka Investments) uses the 'Climate Private Equity / Catalytic Capital / Venture Investment Intake Form' workflow governed by GFANZ Catalytic Capital Repository / Impact Management Project (IMP) / IRIS+ Climate Metrics. Typical review timeline is 4–10 weeks (Pitch Screening -> Commercial & Climate DD -> IC Approval). Form sections required: 1. Venture / Asset Overview, 2. Investment Thesis, 3. Product & Execution, 4. Impact & Risk, 5. Executive Pitch.
